title: Alchemy Tales Devlog: Reached True Immortality and Run Out of Things to Do? Build a Sect
author: Ok-Construction6990
selftext:
Brew pills, cultivate, survive heavenly tribulations, and become a True Immortal. What comes next?

I've recently added a new path to Alchemy Tales: building your own cultivation sect.

https://i.redd.it/pyibevgu4mxh1.png

Build a main hall, a scripture library, herb gardens, and a forge. Lay paths, connect walls, and choose materials and roof styles to gradually make the place your own.

Then you'll need people to fill it. Recruit disciples, assign their duties, give them equipment, and teach them cultivation techniques. Watch them progress through each stage of cultivation before facing a heavenly tribulation to reach the next realm.

When enemies attack, your disciples defend the sect. Between battles, you can send them on expeditions into secret realms. Survivors return with cultivation experience, while any techniques and artifacts they find go into the sect's stores for you to distribute. Of course, some disciples may never return.

Day turns to night automatically, and the stone lanterns light up the courtyards after dark.

https://i.redd.it/zaztow5w4mxh1.png

Lately, I've been polishing how buildings fit together, along with combat, the UI, and the save system.
